edition.name: online
edition.title: About this online version
paragraphs: To keep costs down, this online version offers only the lower-cost options: an economical AI model, your browser's built-in voice, and a simple animated face.

A full version adds more capable AI models (such as Claude Opus and GPT-6), more natural voices, and lifelike video faces. It runs on your own computer, and you connect your own accounts with those providers, so you pay them directly for what you use.
Setting it up takes about 15 minutes and involves no programming. Step-by-step directions, written for readers without a technical background, are on GitHub.
